name: vol_breakout_squeeze_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, intraday volatility contracts sharply when institutional algorithms pause their directional TWAP/VWAP programs — market makers narrow spreads and the index oscillates in a tiny range. When BOTH the 60-second ATR drops to its 5-minute minimum AND Bollinger Band width falls below the 10th percentile of the past 5 minutes, every resting order in the book is priced very tightly around fair value. The dual-squeeze filter (vs single indicator) identifies only the deepest compressions, where the subsequent expansion bar — triggered by a new directional institutional order hitting the book — is a genuine burst rather than noise. At 5-second resolution we enter on the exact first expansion bar, capturing the initial 12-20 spot point burst that occurs before the next re-compression in 15-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Dual squeeze (ATR at 5-min minimum AND BB width below 10th percentile) followed by expansion bar with volume surge
